name: fullstack-starter
description: TypeScript fullstack workflow with existing PostgreSQL, static web and Docker-optional low-cost deployment.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use this repository's fullstack-starter skill to implement my feature with shared contracts and verified platform behavior.
